about: Props made with Roblox Studio's mesh generator (29 Oct 2026, owner: 'remake all lanterns, gas pumps and all stands', 'you use the wrong backpacks'). Each generation was published as a Model asset on the owner's account; the templates built from them live in the place at ServerStorage.GenProps (server/Models swaps them in by name). To rebuild a template: insert the asset, turn it so its front faces -Z (frontYaw below: the mesh's own front was its -Z for 0, its +Z for 180), stand its feet at the origin (the lamp: under the post), and copy the attributes listed here.

lantern_post.notes: LanternCore (invisible part with a PointLight) at the Lantern's centre; attribute LightAt. Fitted to the old lamp's height at runtime.

bag_satchel.notes: Grass Satchel: burlap sack with a clover

bag_backpack.notes: Clipping Backpack: green canvas, brown straps

bag_hiker.notes: Expedition Pack: blue with a red bedroll

bag_infinite.notes: Bottomless Sack: purple with cyan stars

stall_isles.notes: its name goes on the blank panel on the counter's front

stallAttributes: SignAt (CFrame, the name panel's middle, front toward -Z, tilted with the board), SignSize (Vector2), CounterAt / CounterSize (Vector3: the invisible counter collider the prompt hangs on). Measured with rays on each stall in Studio, then checked by eye with test text.
